brief:
National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir joined hundreds of Israelis in a heavily guarded incursion into the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound, according to Al Jazeera English. During the visit, Ben-Gvir declared "we are the owners of the place in Al-Aqsa," asserting Israeli claims to the site.

The storming of the compound represents a high-profile demonstration by a senior Israeli official at one of Islam's holiest sites, located in occupied East Jerusalem.
dek: Israeli national security minister declares 'we are the owners of the place in Al-Aqsa' amid heavily guarded incursion.
title: Israeli security minister storms Al-Aqsa compound with hundreds of supporters
